_comentario: Passo a passo em ingles, escrito a mao, para os 5 exercicios cuja fonte original (free-exercise-db) nao tem nenhum texto de instrucao — sem isso, nao daria para montar a versao em ingles do catalogo bilingue. Mesmo estilo do instrucoes_pt.json: 3-6 passos, do setup ao movimento. Editar este arquivo e rodar python tools/build_catalog.py --dados.
iron-cross: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height, forming a T with your body.
Keeping your arms in that position, squat down by bending your hips and knees, like a regular squat, without letting your arms drop.
Stand back up, keeping your torso upright and your arms extended out to the sides the whole time.
Repeat, keeping constant tension on the shoulders throughout the set.
one-arm-kettlebell-swings: Stand with your feet a bit wider than shoulder width, holding a kettlebell in one hand in front of your body.
Hinge at the hips and swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward forcefully to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, letting the power come from your hips, not your arms.
Let the kettlebell swing back between your legs and repeat, switching hands halfway through the set.
push-press: Stand with the bar racked on the front of your shoulders, feet at hip width — this is the starting position.
Bend your knees slightly in a short dip, without moving your hips back.
Reverse the motion forcefully, driving through your legs and extending your knees to launch the bar upward, finishing by pressing it out with your arms until it locks out overhead.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control and repeat.
side-bridge: Lie on your side, supporting your body on your forearm, elbow aligned under your shoulder, legs stacked and extended.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from head to feet — this is the working position.
Hold the position, keeping your core braced and your hips up, without letting them drop.
Hold for the prescribed time, then switch sides.
side-jackknife: Lie on your side on the floor, legs stacked and extended, with your bottom arm supporting your head.
Place your top hand behind your head or crossed over your chest — this is the starting position.
Contract your obliques to lift your torso and legs at the same time, bringing your ribs toward your hips, like a side jackknife.
Lower back down slowly under control, repeat, then switch sides.
